plain: By 1974 the official line on UFOs seemed to "flip," Michels says, and the documentary UFOs: Past, Present and Future came out that year, following the US Air Force's Blue Book study of the 1950s and 60s and the University of Colorado's Condon report of October 1968. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and in another episode adds that the television writer Rod Serling, his father's godfather, worked on what Michels calls the preeminent UFO documentary, which he did not know until recently.
